lucy-guo.summary: Historical [Forbes reporting](https://www.forbes.com/sites/kerryadolan/2025/04/17/this-ai-founder-lucy-guo-scale-ai-has-unseated-taylor-swift-as-the-worlds-youngest-self-made-woman-billionaire/) put her total at $1.25 billion in its June 2025 update; the [year-end report](https://www.forbes.com/sites/aliciapark/2025/12/25/ai-minted-more-than-50-new-billionaires-in-2025/) estimated $1.4 billion. These are paper-wealth estimates, not disclosed sale proceeds.
